problemSigns.sign: Opener hums but the door doesn't move
problemSigns.detail: The motor runs, but the door stays stationary. This often points to a worn drive gear or a broken belt/chain.

problemSigns.sign: Door reverses before touching the floor
problemSigns.detail: The garage door starts to close, then reverses back up. This indicates an issue with safety sensors or incorrect force settings.
Your remote controls or wall-mounted keypad no longer activate the garage door. This can be a battery, programming, or logic board issue.
The small lights on your safety sensors near the bottom of the door track are blinking. This signals an obstruction or misalignment.

problemSigns.sign: Trolley moves but door stays down
problemSigns.detail: The opener trolley travels along the rail, but the garage door itself does not move. This typically means the emergency release is engaged or the carriage is broken.
